title: Meta Doubles Down on AI Spending, Plans New Class C Shares
text: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Meta's plans to boost AI spending and release new Class C shares to ensure CEO Mark Zuckerberg stays in California if a wealth tax is passed. Plus, Tesla reported strong profit, but a big cut to its spending plans is raising questions about Elon Musk's AI, robotaxi and robotics goals for the company as it weighs a potential merger with SpaceX. And OpenAI's models helped find a potentially catastrophic software vulnerability. OpenAI President Greg Brockman and Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince explain how AI is enabling both defenders and hackers. (Source: Bloomberg)
